item.title: Connecting with agriculture partners
item.description: By Matt Joski, Kewaunee County Sheriff -- Over the past few weeks, I have had some great opportunities to engage with our agriculture industry partners, both locally and statewide.

item.title: NWTC Career Classes Give Students a Head Start in the Workforce
item.description: Adam Collins -- Students at Northeast Wisconsin Technical College are gaining more than just technical skills, they're learning how to navigate the job market before graduation.

item.title: Crossroads wraps up 2026 Fish Tales Series
item.description: By Coggin Heeringa, Crossroads at Big Creek -- This week, Crossroads at Big Creek hosts the final program in the Fish Tales Lecture Series, featuring one of our favorite presenters, Dr. Dan Isermann.

item.title: Syrup season begins to flow in Northeast Wisconsin
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Seeing your neighbors tend to buckets, bags and tubing in the woods will become a common sight in the coming days and weeks as sap collection season begins in Northeast Wisconsin.

item.title: WHS says Spring Is the Perfect Time to Microchip Your Pet
item.description: Adam Collins -- With warmer weather approaching, the Wisconsin Humane Society is reminding Door County pet owners that spring is an ideal time to microchip their animals.

item.title: Sister Bay man airlifted following single-vehicle crash
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A 66-year-old Sister Bay man blames a vehicle that crossed over the centerline for the events that led to him being airlifted following an accident Friday afternoon.

item.title: Wisconsin Supreme Court Justice Ziegler announces she will not seek re-election
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Just under a month after a new Wisconsin Supreme Court justice will be elected, another has announced she will end her tenure next year.

item.title: Fire causes $20,000 in damage to Egg Harbor home
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- If you did not use the start of daylight saving time to check your smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, Egg Harbor Fire Chief Justin MacDonald has a good reason why you should do it now.

item.title: Interest in astronomy going sky-high
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Thanks to events that are out of this world, you will find more people looking to the skies these days.

item.title: How to battle job fair anxiety
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- If being in a room with a bunch of potential employers makes you nervous, you are not alone.
